verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects documents built-in insights charts that can be filtered and custom-created, plus project status updates ("On track"/"At risk") with Markdown messages, which together support reporting on progress. There is no evidence of a composable dashboard with multiple widgets. missing for 10: a documented multi-widget dashboard builder, details on chart types and progress metrics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress

citations.quote: You can apply filters to the default chart and also create your own charts.
You can set a status, such as "On track" or "At risk", to allow people to quickly determine the current state of the project.
Project templates include the views, custom fields, draft issues and associated fields, configured workflows (except any auto-add workflows), and insights.
